title: TCG - DECK MASTERS
author: Grecoh073
selftext:
Dear player,

I would like to invite you to be among the first to play Deck Masters and to help us finish the game.

What is Deck Masters?  
Deck Masters is a dark-fantasy collectible card game for Android and PC. You collect monsters and heroes from six  
rival realms, build your own deck, and battle the computer and other players. Every card has its own skills, and  
heroes build up Rage during battle before unleashing their hero skill. The game is made by a small independent  
team with one motto: "Made by TCG lovers, for TCG lovers."

What is already in the game?  
  \- 294 cards: 258 monsters and 36 heroes, including six Divine heroes such as Athena, Zeus and Hades;  
  \- more than 340 skills and 196 runes;  
  \- a campaign of 360 battles across 12 regions, on three difficulties;  
  \- the Ranked Colosseum with season leaderboards, live 1v1 duels and the new live 2v2:  
two teams of two, where you play together with an ally;  
  \- Trials, weekend events and a monthly Festival;  
  \- daily rewards, an Altar to summon new cards and an Enchant chamber to make your cards stronger;  
  \- no pay-to-win: gems cannot be bought.

Where do we stand?  
Deck Masters is largely complete. The core of the game works and is fully playable. Some parts are still being  
finished and improved, such as card balance, a few screens and the new 2v2 mode.  
If the game does not find enough players for a live battle, computer players fill the empty seats.  
That is exactly why we are looking for testers: your experience will help us get the final steps right.

What do we ask of you?  
  \- Play Deck Masters for at least two weeks, ideally a few times a week.  
  \- Join our test nights to play live against other testers. Dates are announced on our Discord.  
  \- Report bugs and ideas on our Discord, preferably with a screenshot.  
  \- Fill in a short survey at the end (about five minutes).

What do you get in return?  
  \- You play Deck Masters before anyone else.  
  \- Your feedback helps shape the game.  
  \- On our Discord you get the Founder role, for everyone who helped with the beta.

Practical information  
  \- Platform: an Android phone or tablet (64-bit), or a Windows PC (Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit).  
  \- The game is fully online; an internet connection is required.  
  \- The game is in English.  
  \- Download size (versions of 26 October): about 1.5 GB on Android and 3.1 GB on PC (about 3.3 GB unpacked).  
Wi-Fi is recommended.  
  \- On Android you install the test version outside the Play Store. The download links and short instructions  
are on our Discord, in the how-to-install channel (they are download buttons there too).  
  \- Still have the Android test version of 23 October? Uninstall it first, or the new version will not install.  
  \- Taking part is free of charge. Nothing is for sale during the beta.  
  \- You may share screenshots and videos of the beta on social media, ideally with #DeckMasters.  
  \- Our Discord welcomes you in your own language: there are channels in 14 languages.

Join through our Discord: https://discord.gg/s3n27f9VSw  
You can also download it directly:  
  Windows: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VoeuUHm9GjYFUxyruhF7w2asZkL7Kt2u?usp=drive\_link  
  Android: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1eV4ikuQS4FS1pjtEVSwlcZ2a1Gk-gkXE?usp=drive\_link

Thank you for your interest. I look forward to meeting you in the arena.

Kind regards,

Gio  
Creator of Deck Masters  
Discord: https://discord.gg/s3n27f9VSw
